title: I Love the Lord

questions.question: I love the Lord, because he has heard my voice and my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 116:1 (ESV): "I love the Lord, because he has heard my voice and my pleas for mercy."

questions.question: Because he inclined his ear to me, therefore I will call on him how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 116:2 (ESV): "...therefore I will call on him as long as I live."

questions.question: The snares of death encompassed me; the pangs of Sheol laid hold on whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 116:3 (ESV): "...the pangs of Sheol laid hold on me;"

questions.question: Then I called on the name of the Lord: "O Lord, I pray, deliver my what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 116:4 (ESV): "...O Lord, I pray, deliver my soul!"

questions.question: Gracious is the Lord, and righteous; our God is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 116:5 (ESV): "Gracious is the Lord, and righteous; our God is merciful."

questions.question: The Lord preserves the simple; when I was brought low, he saved whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 116:6 (ESV): "...when I was brought low, he saved me."

questions.question: Return, O my soul, to your rest; for the Lord has dealt bountifully with whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 116:7 (ESV): "...for the Lord has dealt bountifully with you."

questions.question: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from what?
I will walk before the Lord in the land of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 116:9 (ESV): "I will walk before the Lord in the land of the living."

questions.question: I believed, even when I spoke: "I am greatly what?"
I said in my alarm, "All mankind are what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 116:11 (ESV): "I said in my alarm, 'All mankind are liars.'"

questions.question: What shall I render to the Lord for all his benefits to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 116:12 (ESV): "What shall I render to the Lord for all his benefits to me?"

questions.question: I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 116:13 (ESV): "I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord,"

questions.question: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 116:15 (ESV): "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints."

questions.question: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 116:17 (ESV): "...and call on the name of the Lord."

key_verse_text: I love the Lord, because he has heard my voice and my pleas for mercy. Because he inclined his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
